nodes.label: Retrospective P2 - Backend APIs
nodes.description: P2 retrospective: ~53 routes, 118 tests, 6 commits, 11 bugs encountered (mostly MikroORM 7 quirks).

nodes.label: Lesson: MikroORM 7 raw() Required
nodes.description: Why: SUM/MAX/COUNT/COALESCE in select() are treated as column names. Must wrap with raw() from @mikro-orm/core.

nodes.label: Lesson: repository.insert() Bypasses Hooks
nodes.description: Why: insert() bypasses onCreate/onUpdate MikroORM hooks. Use em.create() + em.flush() or explicitly set timestamps.

nodes.label: Lesson: Success Criteria = Mandatory Checklist
nodes.description: Why: P2 was initially declared done without writing required tests. Each criterion must be explicitly verified before done/.

nodes.label: Lesson: /auth/login Body Flat (not JSON:API)
nodes.description: Why: Login route accepts flat {email, password, deviceInfo?} body, not JSON:API document format. Asymmetry to document.

nodes.label: Lesson: Sanity-fail Tests Before Declaring Success
nodes.description: Why: Force a temporary test failure to confirm runner is actually executing code, before announcing 'X tests green'.
nodes.norm_label: lesson: sanity-fail tests before declaring success

nodes.label: Lesson: Commit-as-you-go
nodes.description: Why: Retrofitting commits per sub-phase at end was messy. Commit at each sub-phase boundary instead.

nodes.label: Lesson: mounters.ts Pattern (>3 prefixes)
nodes.description: Why: When a module handles >3 prefixes, factor into mounters.ts to keep init.ts under oxlint max-lines.

nodes.label: Workaround: TimeTrackingPort
nodes.description: scrum-backend needs time_entries data for dashboard (cross bounded context). Resolved via TimeTrackingPort interface + SqlTimeTrackingAdapter (hexagonal).

nodes.label: Libs Rules (Monorepo)
nodes.summary: Regles du dossier @libs: deux familles (backend tsdown/oxlint, frontend Embroider/Rollup/ESLint). Definit les dependances inter-libs autorisees.

nodes.label: Backend Libs Family
nodes.summary: Famille libs backend (TS Fastify, build tsdown, lint oxlint+oxfmt). Inclut backend-shared, users-backend; futurs P1+: projects/backlog/sprints/time-tracking.

nodes.label: Frontend Libs Family
nodes.summary: Famille libs frontend (Addons Ember v2 Embroider, build Rollup, ESLint+Prettier+template-lint). Pas d'oxlint.

nodes.label: Inter-lib Dependency Rules
nodes.summary: backend-shared sans dep; users-backend peut importer backend-shared; shared-front base de tout; users-front/todos-front jamais l'une l'autre (pas de cycle).

nodes.label: users-backend Module
nodes.summary: Module Fastify domaine Users + Auth. AuthModule /auth (login/logout/refresh public) + UserModule /users (CRUD protege JWT). Prefixes /api/v1/*.

nodes.label: JWT Auth Flow (access+refresh+familyId)
nodes.summary: Login -> argon2 verify -> generateTokens (access 15m, refresh 7d) -> stocke hash + familyId. Rotation a refresh. FamilyId detecte reutilisation -> invalide toute la famille.

nodes.label: Login body asymmetry (flat vs JSON:API)
nodes.summary: POST /auth/login accepte un body flat {email, password}, PAS le format JSON:API {data:{attributes:...}}. Exception au reste du projet.

nodes.label: createJwtAuthMiddleware
nodes.summary: Hook preValidation Fastify. Factory (em, jwtSecret). Reutilise par todos-backend pour proteger ses routes.

nodes.label: RefreshTokenEntity
nodes.summary: Entite refresh token: hash, deviceInfo, expiry, familyId, revokedAt. Permet rotation + detection reutilisation.

nodes.label: time-tracking-backend Add-on
nodes.summary: Add-on separe du bounded context Scrum (Scrum gere story points, pas heures). Concu remplacable (Toggl/Harvest). FK cross-lib string-only (taskId, userId, projectId).

nodes.label: TimeEntry Entity
nodes.summary: Heures travaillees sur une tache/utilisateur/jour. projectId denormalise pour rapports. PK UUID v4.

nodes.label: todos-backend Module
nodes.summary: Module Fastify CRUD Todos sur /api/v1/todos/*. Toutes routes protegees par jwtAuthMiddleware (importe de users-backend).

nodes.label: Ownership rule (404 not 403)
nodes.summary: Routes get/update/delete verifient todo.owner === request.user.id. Retourne 404 (pas 403) pour ne pas leaker l'existence.

nodes.label: scrum-backend Bounded Context
nodes.summary: Bounded context Scrum: Project, Epic, UserStory, Task, Sprint + child entities (ProjectMember, TaskAssignee, Comment, Attachment, HistoryEntry). EXCLUT TimeEntry.

nodes.label: FK cross-lib string-only convention
nodes.summary: Toutes FK vers users-backend sont string IDs (userId, responsibleId). Pas de relation MikroORM cross-lib. Populate via repository en P2.

nodes.label: Task.number applicatif (MAX+1 in transaction)
nodes.summary: Task.number: entier unique par projet, implemente applicativement (MAX + 1 dans une transaction) en P2. Pas de sequence Postgres.

nodes.label: users-front Addon
nodes.summary: Addon Ember v2 UI Users: login/logout/forgot-password + CRUD users. Services current-user, user. Mocks MSW. Schemas Zod alignes sur backend.

nodes.label: API types regen (pnpm api:types)
nodes.summary: Si desynchro Zod front/back -> 'cd @apps/backend && pnpm api:types' regenere les types. S'applique aussi a todos-front.

nodes.label: todos-front Addon
nodes.summary: Addon Ember v2 UI Todos: routes index/create/edit, todo-form, todo-table, service todo, changesets (ember-changeset), mocks MSW.

nodes.label: backend-shared Helpers
nodes.summary: Lib bas niveau: serialization/json-api (makeJsonApiDocumentSchema, makeJsonApiError), error-handler (handleJsonApiErrors), module.ts (Route, ModuleInterface). Pas de logique metier.

nodes.label: MikroORM 7 Postgres pitfalls
nodes.summary: 1) raw() obligatoire pour SQL dans .select() (SUM/MAX/COALESCE). 2) createQueryBuilder uniquement sur SqlEntityManager. 3) insert() bypass onCreate/onUpdate -> remplir manuellement createdAt/updatedAt.

nodes.label: Route<T> + ModuleInterface<T>
nodes.summary: Interfaces: Route<T> avec routeDefinition(f:T):void; ModuleInterface<T> avec setupRoutes(fastify:T):Promise<void>. Standard implemente par tous modules.

nodes.label: shared-front Addon
nodes.summary: Addon Ember v2 base de tout le front: theme.css (design tokens SprintForge teal dark/light pour Tailwind v4), services theme/error-reporter/handle-save.

nodes.label: SprintForge Design Tokens
nodes.summary: theme.css avec palette teal, sidebar, dark/light. Expose a Tailwind v4 via @theme inline.

nodes.label: Backend Boilerplate Tutorial
nodes.summary: Tutoriel structure d'une lib backend (todos-backend). Module Fastify, JSON:API, Zod, classes Route, tests integration testcontainers + transactions rollback.

nodes.label: Integration tests: testcontainers + rollback
nodes.summary: Tests integration: vraie DB Postgres via @testcontainers/postgresql, isolation par em.begin()/em.rollback() autour de chaque test (aroundEach Vitest).

nodes.label: Frontend Boilerplate Tutorial
nodes.summary: Tutoriel structure d'une lib frontend (todos-front). initialize(owner), moduleRegistry(), forRouter(DSL), Warp Drive schemas, MSW mocks. Pas de tests d'acceptance dans les libs.

nodes.label: Translations live in apps, keys in libs
nodes.summary: Libs exportent uniquement des cles de traduction. App fournit le fichier YAML par locale et lib (ex: @apps/front/app/translations/todos/en-us.yaml).
